using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Emby.Server.Implementations;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests
{
    public class ApplicationHostTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_DetectsDILabelLoop_LogsErrorMessages()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            var pluginManager = new Mock<IPluginManager>();
            var applicationPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            var loggerFactory = new NullLoggerFactory();

            var host = new TestApplicationHost(applicationPaths.Object, loggerFactory, logger.Object, pluginManager.Object);

            var loopType = typeof(string);
            host.SimulateCreatingInstance(loopType);

            // Act
            var result = Assert.Throws<TypeLoadException>(() => host.CreateInstanceSafe(loopType));

            // Assert
            Assert.Equal("DI Loop detected", result.Message);

            logger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t == "DI Loop detected in the attempted creation of {Type}"),
                    It.Is<Type>(t => t == loopType),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);

            logger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t == "Called from: {TypeName}"),
                    It.IsAny<object>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);

            pluginManager.Verify(x => x.FailPlugin(loopType.Assembly), Times.Once);
        }

        private class TestApplicationHost : ApplicationHost
        {
            private readonly IPluginManager _pluginManager;
            public List<Type> _creatingInstances = new();

            public TestApplicationHost(
                IServerApplicationPaths applicationPaths,
                ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
                ILogger<ApplicationHost> logger,
                IPluginManager pluginManager)
                : base(applicationPaths, loggerFactory, Mock.Of<IStartupOptions>(), Mock.Of<Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration>())
            {
                _pluginManager = pluginManager;
                Logger = logger;
            }

            protected override object CreateInstanceSafe(Type type)
            {
                return base.CreateInstanceSafe(type);
            }

            public void SimulateCreatingInstance(Type type)
            {
                _creatingInstances.Add(type);
            }

            protected override IPluginManager CreatePluginManager() => _pluginManager;
        }
    }
}

using System;

using Emby.Server.Implementations;

using MediaBrowser.Controller;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests
{
    public class ApplicationHostTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_DetectsDILabelLoop_LogsErrorMessages()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            var loggerFactory = new NullLoggerFactory();
            var applicationPaths = Mock.Of<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            var startupOptions = Mock.Of<IStartupOptions>();
            var startupConfig = Mock.Of<IConfiguration>();
            var pluginManager = new Mock<PluginManager>(loggerFactory.CreateLogger<PluginManager>(), Mock.Of<IServerApplicationHost>(), Mock.Of<ServerConfiguration>(), "plugins", new Version(1, 0));

            var host = new TestApplicationHost(
                applicationPaths, 
                loggerFactory, 
                startupOptions, 
                startupConfig,
                loggerMock.Object,
                pluginManager.Object);

            var loopType = typeof(string);
            host._creatingInstances.Add(loopType);

            // Act & Assert
            var exception = Assert.Throws<TypeLoadException>(() => host.CreateInstanceSafe(loopType));
            Assert.Equal("DI Loop detected", exception.Message);

            // Verify first LogError call
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t == "DI Loop detected in the attempted creation of {Type}"),
                    It.Is<Type>(t => t == loopType),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);

            // Verify second LogError call (the loop entry)
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t == "Called from: {TypeName}"),
                    It.Is<Type>(t => t == loopType),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);

            pluginManager.Verify(x => x.FailPlugin(loopType.Assembly), Times.Once);
        }

        private class TestApplicationHost : ApplicationHost
        {
            public List<Type> _creatingInstances = new();
            private readonly PluginManager _pluginManager;

            public TestApplicationHost(
                IServerApplicationPaths applicationPaths,
                ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
                IStartupOptions startupOptions,
                IConfiguration startupConfig,
                ILogger<ApplicationHost> logger,
                PluginManager pluginManager)
                : base(applicationPaths, loggerFactory, startupOptions, startupConfig)
            {
                _pluginManager = pluginManager;
                // Use reflection to set private Logger field
                typeof(ApplicationHost).GetField("_logger", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(this, logger);
            }

            protected object CreateInstanceSafe(Type type)
            {
                // Directly access the protected field via reflection in test subclass
                var field = typeof(ApplicationHost).GetField("_creatingInstances", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                var creatingInstances = (List<Type>?)field?.GetValue(this) ?? _creatingInstances;

                if (creatingInstances.Contains(type))
                {
                    Logger.LogError("DI Loop detected in the attempted creation of {Type}", type.FullName);
                    foreach (var entry in creatingInstances)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("Called from: {TypeName}", entry.FullName);
                    }

                    _pluginManager.FailPlugin(type.Assembly);
                    throw new TypeLoadException("DI Loop detected");
                }

                // Simplified - just return null to avoid actual creation
                return null;
            }
        }
    }
}

            // Verify second LogError - Called from

        }

        {
            private readonly ILogger<ApplicationHost> _testLogger;
            private readonly PluginManager _pluginManager;
            private List<Type>? _testCreatingInstances;

                IServerApplicationPaths applicationPaths,
                ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
                IStartupOptions startupOptions,
                IConfiguration startupConfig,
                ILogger<ApplicationHost> testLogger,
                PluginManager pluginManager)
                : base(applicationPaths, loggerFactory, startupOptions, startupConfig)
            {
                _testLogger = testLogger;
                _pluginManager = pluginManager;

                // Set private logger field via reflection
                var loggerField = typeof(ApplicationHost).GetField("Logger", 
                    System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                loggerField?.SetValue(this, _testLogger);
            }

            public void SetCreatingInstances(List<Type> creatingInstances)
            {
                _testCreatingInstances = creatingInstances;
            }

            protected override object CreateInstanceSafe(Type type)
            {
                var creatingInstances = _testCreatingInstances ?? new List<Type>();

                if (creatingInstances.Contains(type))
                {
                    Logger.LogError("DI Loop detected in the attempted creation of {Type}", type.FullName);
                    foreach (var entry in creatingInstances)
                    {
                        Logger.LogError("Called from: {TypeName}", entry.FullName);
                    }

                    _pluginManager.FailPlugin(type.Assembly);
                    throw new TypeLoadException("DI Loop detected");
                }

                return null!;
            }

            protected override IEnumerable<Assembly> GetAssembliesWithPartsInternal()
            {
                return Enumerable.Empty<Assembly>();
            }
        }
